player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwi-Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma esikhulu {num_rounds} izikhathi.

Isakhiwo seGame:
- Phambi kokuthatha isigqibo, unazo {total_conversation_rounds} amathuba okuthetha ngokukhululeka.
- Emva koko, abadlali bobabini bakhetha ukusebenzisana okanye ukukhetha ukungasebenzisani ngaxesha nye.

Imatrix yePhumelelo (eyiliwe kila xesha):
- Bobabini Basebenzisana ➜ ilungu ngalinye {cooperate_reward}
- Bobabini Bakhethe Ukungasebenzisani ➜ ilungu ngalinye {mutual_defect_reward}
- Omnye Ukhethe Ukungasebenzisani, omnye Usebenzisana ➜ Ongakhetha Ukungasebenzisani {defect_reward}, Osebenzisana {sucker_reward}

Indlela yokudlala:
- Ngexesha lokuthetha: bhala nantoni na ufuna.
- Ngexesha lokuthatha isigqibo: bandakanya '[Cooperate]' okanye '[Defect]' (ayikho kubaluleka ukubhala ngobuninzi). Ungafaka izwi zantsi ngaphambi/ emva kwesigqibo.

phases.conversation_finished: Ingxoxo iphelile kwi-round {round}. Nceda phendula ngokuthi '[Cooperate]' okanye '[Defect]' ngaphakathi kwe-\boxed{{}}.
